title: Design: Tracking switched off on a part looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active, tracked part, part A, with stock in one bin and a saved Min and Max.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 5.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed with a quantity in Total Qty.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch blue and Min and Max shown.

Step 3:

  • The switch turns grey with its knob at the left.
  • Min and Max are gone and Tags sits directly under the switch.
  • The bin row still shows part A's bin, its quantity and the "Default" tag.
  • The window stays open with no message and no confirmation.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and part A's Total Qty still shows a quantity: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R3: “Turning tracking off hides Min and Max in the part dialog. It does not change the quantity in any bin.”
  • S5-R3a: “The bin locations and their quantities stay visible in the part dialog, as a shelf reference (S4-R6).”
  • S5-R5: “Turning tracking off asks for no confirmation, whatever the part holds.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
